steps.message:
Add the following recipes into the Broccoli app:
title|description|servings|preparationTime|ingredients|directions
Butternut Squash Soup|A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.|1 serving|20 mins|see directions|Sauté onions and garlic, add cubed butternut squash and broth. Puree until smooth and season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
BBQ Chicken Quesadillas|A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.|3-4 servings|45 mins|see directions|Mix shredded cooked chicken with BBQ sauce. Place on tortillas with cheese, fold and cook until crispy. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.
Avocado Toast with Egg|A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.|8 servings|4 hrs|n/a|Toast bread, top with mashed avocado, a fried egg, salt, pepper, and chili flakes. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i broccoli"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i broccoli""
